GSE230375_input: Raw-count SingleCellExperiment; colData carries sample and cell_type
construction: MuSiC receives sample as the subject label and cell_type as the cluster label; cell-type profiles are informed by between-donor consistency weighting.
transformation_or_selection: Raw counts are supplied to MuSiC; no marker-only restriction is applied in donor-reference workflow.
boundary: Shares the GSE230375 source with pseudobulk and is not independent validation.

construction: Cross-cell mean expression per broad cell type from the processed matrix; pooled cell-level means, not equal-weight donor means.
transformation_or_selection: Clamp mean log-normalized values at zero, apply expm1, rank cell-type specificity as log2((target+0.05)/(maximum other+0.05)), and union up to 200 markers per type with expression >0.05.
boundary: Marker-restricted NNLS provides a sensitivity reference; estimated fractions are not validated absolute tissue proportions.
